messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout 'rl-v2' — spike in 429s from rate-limiter in eu-west1. Affected paths: /v1/generate (token-accounting). Severity: critical. Paging @zoe (oncall).
zoe (oncall): on it, thanks. can someone post the top-level impact? which customers? :rotating_light:
maya (support): getting reports from 3 enterprise customers (org-omega, org-gamma, internal-test). Tickets show repeated `quota_exceeded` errors even though they should be exempt.
sanjay (eng-sre): observed same on metrics — 10x increase in 429s starting at 09:12 UTC coincident with canary traffic shift to rl-v2. Exemptions table looks unchanged in legacy store, but new RL service is returning 429 for exempt tokens.
lina (eng-runtime): digging into canary config — rl-v2 introduced a new token normalization step. hypothesis: normalization mismatch => token ids don't match exemptions. pulling logs now.
jeff (eng-manager): if exemptions are not honored this is customer-impacting. Recommend kill-switch for rl-v2 and rollback canary while we triage. @zoe can you coordinate rollback?
zoe (oncall): initiating kill-switch for the canary rollout flag `rl_canary_enabled` -> false. Will notify deploy-bot.
incident-bot: Deploy request submitted: flip feature flag `rl_canary_enabled=false` by zoe. CI safe-check passed.
zoe (oncall): flag flipped. rolling off canary traffic to rl-v1. monitoring.
sanjay (eng-sre): quick check: invoking test token that is on exemptions list against rl-v2: response=429, headers show `x-rl-version: rl-v2`, `x-reason: token_not_found_in_map`. on rl-v1 same token -> 200.
lina (eng-runtime): found the mismatch — rl-v2 lowercases token IDs during normalization, but exemptions were stored mixed-case in exemptions-service. normalization should've been part of migration. patch ready: remove normalization in rl-v2 and add compatibility layer.
jeff (eng-manager): good catch. for now keep rl-v2 disabled. can we do a hotfix to rl-v2 that skips normalization and re-run canary in a small subset?
sanjay (eng-sre): hotfix built (branch: rl-v2/compat-token-map). small checklist: 1) unit tests for token mapping 2) integration test with exemptions-service 3) canary traffic -> 5% non-prod.
maya (support): customers asking for ETA. I told them we rolled back the canary and are hotfixing; will update once canary passes tests.
zoe (oncall): metrics after flag flip: 429s dropped to baseline within 30s for all affected orgs. Paging cleared. continuing post-rollback monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated (kill-switch applied). Severity downgraded to major.
lina (eng-runtime): running integration test against staging exemptions service: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer EXEMPT_TOKEN" https://rl-canary.staging/v1/generate` -> 200 after compatibility patch. adding presubmit.
sanjay (eng-sre): prepping a gradual canary replay once CI green. will also run a db-sync job that lowercases exemption keys into a compatibility column (read-path first, write-back later). plan: run no-write migration first.
jeff (eng-manager): postmortem owners: root cause — token normalization introduced without coordinated exemptions migration; remediation — add compatibility layer + migration, tighten rollout checklist. assign owners: lina -> runtime patch, sanjay -> migration + rollout plan, maya -> customer comms.
zoe (oncall): handing off to sanjay for follow-up. I'm going offline for rotation change in 30m.
sanjay (eng-sre): acknowledged handoff. keeping monitoring alerting suppressed for noise reduction. will create follow-up ticket IN-3245 with timeline and rollforward plan.
maya (support): I'll post a status update to the affected customer threads: "we reverted a canary that impacted exemptions; we are testing a fix and will do a carefully monitored replay; no further action required from you at this time."
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident report in incidents/ with timeline and customer impact tags.
jeff (eng-manager): closing notes for now — mitigation successful, customers restored. escalate if 429s reappear after canary replay.
